description: This PHP class 'TextHelperService' provides utility methods for string manipulation, including functions to determine string length, check if a string contains a substring, starts with, or ends with a specific substring. It also includes compatibility checks for various PHP string functions.

classes.name: TextHelperService
classes.description: A service class offering static-like utility methods for string operations with support for various PHP string functions and encoding considerations.

methods.name: strLength
methods.description: Returns the length of a string, considering encoding if provided. Uses mb_strlen if available, otherwise falls back to strlen.

methods.name: strContains
methods.description: Checks if a haystack string contains a needle substring. Uses str_contains if available; otherwise, uses strpos.

methods.name: strStartsWith
methods.description: Checks if a haystack string starts with a specific substring. Uses str_starts_with if available; otherwise, uses strncmp.

methods.name: strEndsWith
methods.description: Checks if a haystack string ends with a specific substring. Uses str_ends_with if available; otherwise, uses substr_compare.
